europe_now.title: Sweden Election
europe_now.summary: Sweden's left bloc has edged ahead in a tight general election as far-right support slips, though the race remains too close to call.

europe_now.title: EU Sanctions Deadlock
europe_now.summary: The European Union has failed to agree on a rollover of Russia sanctions with just one day remaining before the deadline.

top_stories.title: Swedish General Election Outcomes
top_stories.summary: Sweden's parliamentary election remains exceptionally tight as vote counts continue. The centre-left bloc currently holds a narrow lead over the opposition.

top_stories.title: EU Policy and Sanctions
top_stories.summary: European Union institutions are currently facing internal divisions regarding policy continuity. Member states failed to reach an agreement on rolling over sanctions against Russia ahead of the deadline.
